'''Caroline Poussier''' (born 13 July 1976) is an Andorran [[Alpine skiing|alpine skier]]. She competed in [[Alpine skiing at the 1994 Winter Olympics|two events]] at the [[1994 Winter Olympics]].<ref name="SportsRef">{{cite Sports-Reference |url=https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/po/caroline-poussier-1.html |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200418121520/https://www.sports-reference.com/olympics/athletes/po/caroline-poussier-1.html |url-status=dead |archive-date=18 April 2020 |title=Caroline Poussier Olympic Results |accessdate=29 March 2018}}</ref>
